sampling: Every chronological n in [B,2B); no prime-dependent or phase-dependent deletion, reweighting, or stopping.
adaptation: Prime charts and precision may be repaired from exact arithmetic. Frequencies, chronological shells, thresholds, and signs stay fixed.

outcomes.pass: All controls pass and rigorous finite signed enclosures meet the declared thresholds on this finite shell only.
outcomes.fail: A control fails, source authentication fails, or a rigorous finite bound excludes a declared threshold.
outcomes.ambiguous: An interval straddles a threshold or arithmetic precision is exhausted; preserve the record and do not drop the observation.

proof_boundary: No finite outcome proves R0, a positive liminf, or normality. No new all-shell bound is assumed.
